description: This file defines an Angular component named NoteEditModalComponent used for editing or creating notes within a note management system. It includes input properties, output events, and basic logic for initializing and saving note data.

classes.name: NoteEditModalComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for editing or creating notes, handling user input and emitting save or close events.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, setting the title and content based on the input note.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Emits the save event with the note's title and content if both are non-empty after trimming.
